description: Defines IPC connector classes, interfaces, serialization/deserialization mechanisms, and IPC channel management for Thunder framework.

classes.name: IMessage
classes.description: Interface for messages with serialization/deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: IIPC
classes.description: Interface representing an IPC message with label, parameters, and response.

classes.name: IPCMessageType
classes.description: Template class for specific IPC message types with serialization support.

classes.name: IPCChannel
classes.description: Abstract base class for IPC channels, managing registration, invocation, and response reporting.

classes.name: IPCChannelType
classes.description: Template class extending IPCChannel, implementing source, extension, and link management for specific IPC communication.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes IMessage content into a byte stream.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes byte stream into IMessage content.

methods.name: Procedure
methods.description: Defines procedure to handle incoming IPC messages.

methods.name: ReportResponse
methods.description: Reports response message for an inbound IPC.
